columns.comment: Calendar date of the opportunity creation. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the opportunity creation as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the opportunity creation, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the opportunity creation).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Pipeline stage - Prospecting, Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation (open), Won or Lost (closed).
columns.name: Stage

columns.comment: True while the opportunity is open (not won or lost) at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Is Open

columns.comment: Product pitched (CRM sales product), e.g. Supply Chain Finance, Term Loan, Green Loan, Trade Finance Line, Cash Management Mandate.
columns.name: Product

columns.comment: Product family of the opportunity - Corporate Lending, Supply Chain Finance, Trade Finance, Cash, Liquidity, FX, Rates or Sustainable Finance.
columns.name: Product Family

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter of the expected close, e.g. FY2026-Q3 (Oct-Dec 2026), FY2026-Q4 (Jan-Mar 2027).
columns.name: Expected Close Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half of the expected close, e.g. FY2026-H2 (Oct-2026 to Mar-2027).
columns.name: Expected Close Half

columns.comment: Origin of the opportunity - Signal, RM Originated, Client Request or Referral.
columns.name: Source Type

columns.comment: Signal type of the source signal for signal-sourced opportunities (e.g. TRADE_CORRIDOR_GROWTH, DEPOSIT_SURPLUS); blank otherwise.
columns.name: Source Signal Type

columns.comment: Destination country (ISO-2) of the trade corridor behind a corridor-growth source signal, e.g. VN Vietnam, IN India.
columns.name: Corridor Destination

columns.comment: Opportunities created in the selected period (any stage).
columns.name: Opportunities

columns.comment: Opportunities still open at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Open Opportunities

columns.comment: Amount of the open opportunities in USD (limits / volumes pitched).
columns.name: Pipeline Amount USD

columns.comment: Open amount x stage win probability in USD (0.10 Prospecting, 0.25 Qualification, 0.45 Proposal, 0.70 Negotiation).
columns.name: Weighted Pipeline USD

columns.comment: Expected annual revenue in USD of the open opportunities if won.
columns.name: Expected Revenue USD

columns.comment: Amount of the opportunities won, USD.
columns.name: Won Amount USD

columns.comment: Opportunities won.
columns.name: Opportunities Won

columns.comment: Opportunities won or lost.
columns.name: Opportunities Closed

columns.comment: Won / (won + lost) (fraction, D21) - which sources and products actually convert.
columns.name: Win Rate %

columns.comment: Average days from creation to close for won or lost opportunities.
columns.name: Average Cycle Days

columns.comment: Average days open to 30-Sep-2026 for open opportunities.
columns.name: Average Open Age Days

columns.comment: Open opportunities whose expected close date has already passed.
columns.name: Slipped Opportunities

comment: SMBC APAC sales pipeline, opportunities created Apr-2024 to Sep-2026 (USD): open pipeline amount and probability- weighted value, expected revenue, opportunities won / lost and win rate, cycle time - by stage, product, expected close quarter, owner RM and source (opportunities created from signals carry the signal type and trade corridor). Calendar fields (Fiscal Year, Quarter...) are those of the CREATION date ("created this fiscal year" = Fiscal Year FY2026); Expected Close Quarter / Half are separate fields. Win Rate % = won / (won + lost) (D21). Grain: one row per pipeline opportunity (gold.fact_pipeline_opportunity).
